name: Tougo Magnarten
original_name: トウゴ・マグナーテン
source:
Occupation: Mechanic
Hobbies: Tinkering with mechanics
Skills: Restoring old machines
Likes: Old machines
Dislikes: High-tech machines

The protagonist of the game. He is the childhood friend of Celicia and Celine, because they all grew up in the same orphanage. When he became 18, he left the orphanage and is now working at a local repair shop.
